segments.text:
V. 34.
They underſtood none of theſe things—The literal Meaning they could not but underſtand. But as they could not reconcile this to their preconceived Opinion of the Meſſiah, they were utterly at a Loſs in what parabolical or figurative Senſe to take what He ſaid concerning his Sufferings; having their Thoughts ſtill taken up with the temporal Kingdom.
